junctions.virtual.main_road_only.reason: Implements the referential-integrity sub-case (PARTIAL_DETERMINISTIC): for every @type="virtual" junction, @mainRoad (mandatory on t_junction_virtual) must resolve to an actually-defined <road id=...> in the document; flag if it does not. Residual left uncovered, per assignment scope: the participation-link check (does some <connection> actually attach to @mainRoad, either via @incomingRoad or via the connectingRoad's own <link> back-reference) and the exclusivity judgment ("branches off the main road ONLY" -- distinguishing a legitimate branch/sub-branch road from an unrelated through-road that should have used a common junction requires real-world road-classification/topological-intent reasoning the spec does not reduce to an attribute test) are not implemented here. Validated: 0 exceptions over the full 208-file corpus, 0 flags in the official ASAM set, 0 flags anywhere in the wider corpus (genuinely traced -- every GT-authored virtual-junction fixture declares a @mainRoad that resolves to a defined road). Positive/negative throwaway-fixture detection confirmed: fires when @mainRoad references an undefined road id, correctly suppressed when @mainRoad resolves to a defined road.
